evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: The owned/rented opposition appeals to self-origination (autonomy) and positions ownership as a standing asset (self-enhancement).

evidence.quote: the perspective is the asset you keep.

observations.why: Framing perspective as a kept asset appeals to self-origination and the standing that comes from retaining what is yours.
